title: Senior Manager Administration
description: Role & responsibilities Role Objective The Senior Manager Administration will be responsible for leading the overall administrative and operational excellence of the SOIL School of Business Design campus. The role will ensure efficient management of campus infrastructure, facilities, transportation, travel, security, housekeeping, vendor partnerships, statutory compliance, and institutional events.Working closely with academic leadership, faculty, students, and support functions, the incumbent will create a safe, efficient, student-centric, and service-oriented campus environment while driving operational efficiencies, cost optimization, and high-quality stakeholder experiences.Key Responsibilities1. Campus Administration & FacilitiesLead the overall administration of the campus, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations across academic and administrative facilities. Oversee campus infrastructure, classrooms, meeting spaces, common areas, reception, guest house, cafeteria, and support services to maintain high standards of functionality and aesthetics. Ensure preventive maintenance of campus infrastructure, equipment, utilities, and building services through effective coordination with maintenance teams. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, campus experience, and service delivery. Ensure campus readiness for academic sessions, leadership meetings, student activities, and institutional events.2. Logistics, Travel & TransportationOversee institutional travel, accommodation, transportation, and logistics for faculty, leadership, students, visiting dignitaries, and external stakeholders. Manage the campus transportation fleet, including vehicle utilization, maintenance schedules, fuel management, statutory documentation, and vendor performance. Coordinate logistics for academic programs, field visits, corporate engagements, and student immersion activities. Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies and cost optimization across travel and transportation functions.3. Vendor, Procurement & Contract ManagementLead end-to-end vendor management including identification, onboarding, negotiations, service delivery, renewals, and performance evaluations. Manage service contracts relating to housekeeping, security, transportation, maintenance, hospitality, facility management, and other administrative services. Ensure timely processing of purchase requests, vendor invoices, service agreements, and administrative payments. Drive procurement best practices while ensuring transparency, compliance, and value for money. Build long-term partnerships with reliable vendors to support institutional growth.4. Campus Operations & Support ServicesLead and supervise administrative support teams including housekeeping, security, reception, pantry, drivers, and facility personnel. Ensure high-quality hospitality services for visitors, recruiters, guest speakers, corporate partners, and leadership. Support onboarding logistics for faculty and staff, workspace readiness, and administrative requirements. Develop and implement administrative SOPs to improve operational consistency and service standards. Handle operational escalations proactively and ensure timely resolution of campus-related issues.5. Institutional Events & Guest ExperienceLead planning and execution of institutional events including convocations, conferences, seminars, leadership interactions, corporate events, admissions activities, student events, and official ceremonies. Coordinate logistics, venue management, hospitality, transportation, vendor support, and event operations. Ensure exceptional guest experiences through seamless planning and stakeholder coordination. Collaborate with internal teams to deliver high-quality institutional events aligned with SOIL's standards.6. Compliance, Administration & GovernanceEnsure compliance with institutional policies, statutory requirements, safety protocols, and administrative procedures. Maintain accurate administrative documentation, contracts, asset records, inventories, and operational reports. Support internal and external audits through proper documentation and process adherence. Monitor administrative budgets and ensure effective utilization of resources. Prepare periodic MIS reports and operational dashboards for leadership review.Key Skills & CompetenciesStrong knowledge of campus administration, logistics, travel management, and facility operationsExcellent vendor management and negotiation skillsStrong coordination and stakeholder management abilitiesHigh attention to detail and operational disciplineAbility to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced academic environmentStrong communication and interpersonal skillsProficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace; advanced Excel skills preferredExperience with travel booking systems and administrative reporting is an advantageRequirementsBachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations Management, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification will be an advantage. 8–11 years of progressive experience in administration, facilities management, campus operations, logistics, or institutional administration.Prior experience in higher education institutions, universities, business schools, or large academic campuses is highly preferred. Demonstrated experience in managing campus infrastructure, transportation, travel, hospitality, vendor management, and institutional events. Experience in leading administrative teams and managing multiple stakeholders. Strong understanding of budgeting, procurement processes, statutory compliance, and operational governance. Ability to independently manage operational priorities in a dynamic academic environment.What Success Looks LikeEfficient and well-managed campus operations with high stakeholder satisfaction.Seamless administration, logistics, travel, and event management.Strong vendor partnerships delivering quality services and operational efficiencies.Effective administrative governance with timely compliance and accurate documentation.A safe, service-oriented, and well-maintained campus environment.SOIL is a diverse and inclusive employer, fostering a culture of respect, collaboration, and equal opportunity for all.Preferred candidate profile
